capabilities.name: Customer Management
capabilities.description: Acquiring, serving, and retaining household, business, and developer customers for clean water and wastewater services across all channels.

capabilities.name: Water & Wastewater Treatment
capabilities.description: Abstracting and treating raw water to potable standards, and collecting and treating wastewater to consented discharge quality.

capabilities.name: Water Resources & Wholesale
capabilities.description: Securing long-term water resources and managing bulk supply, inter-company transfers, and wholesale charging.

capabilities.name: Network Operations
capabilities.description: Operating the clean water distribution and wastewater collection networks to move water reliably and safely to and from customers.

capabilities.name: Asset Management
capabilities.description: Planning, acquiring, operating, maintaining, and decommissioning physical assets across the water and wastewater value chain.

capabilities.name: Retail & Billing
capabilities.description: Pricing water and wastewater services, metering consumption, generating bills, and collecting payment.

capabilities.name: Regulatory & Compliance
capabilities.description: Maintaining the right to operate via licensing, regulatory reporting, audits, and drinking-water and environmental obligations.

capabilities.name: Environment & Sustainability
capabilities.description: Reducing leakage, pollution and emissions, improving river and bathing-water quality, and meeting evolving ESG obligations.

capabilities.name: Enterprise Support
capabilities.description: Cross-cutting business support: finance, HR, IT, legal, and procurement.

capabilities.name: Acquire Customer
capabilities.description: Win business-retail customers and developer services, and register new household occupiers across channels.

capabilities.name: Service Customer
capabilities.description: Respond to enquiries, complaints, and service requests across channels.

capabilities.name: Manage Customer Insight
capabilities.description: Understand customer needs, vulnerability, behaviours, and value, and act on that insight.

capabilities.name: Retain Customer
capabilities.description: Renew, save, and grow value with existing business-retail and developer customers.

capabilities.name: Offboard Customer
capabilities.description: Manage the departure of customers, ensuring fair, transparent, and compliant exit from the portfolio.

capabilities.name: Plan Treatment Capacity
capabilities.description: Forecast demand and load and plan treatment-works capacity and process additions.

capabilities.name: Operate Treatment Works
capabilities.description: Run water and wastewater treatment works safely, reliably, and economically against demand and consent.

capabilities.name: Manage Treatment Chemicals & Inputs
capabilities.description: Source, schedule, and manage treatment chemicals, energy, and other process inputs.

capabilities.name: Optimise Treatment Operations
capabilities.description: Optimise process configuration and energy use across the treatment estate against quality and cost.

capabilities.name: Forecast Demand & Resource Availability
capabilities.description: Forecast demand, abstraction headroom, and resource availability across horizons.

capabilities.name: Manage Bulk Supply & Wholesale
capabilities.description: Manage bulk supply, inter-company transfers, and wholesale arrangements with retailers and neighbours.

capabilities.name: Manage Resource & Supply Risk
capabilities.description: Measure and manage drought, resource, and supply-demand-balance risk across the resource zones.

capabilities.name: Settle Wholesale Charges
capabilities.description: Confirm, invoice, and settle wholesale charges with retailers and the market operator.

capabilities.name: Plan Network Investment
capabilities.description: Plan clean-water and wastewater network development against demand growth, resilience, and policy.

capabilities.name: Operate Network
capabilities.description: Run the network within operating limits, including pressure, flow, and storm-overflow management.

capabilities.name: Maintain Network
capabilities.description: Maintain and repair mains, sewers, and pumping assets to sustain reliability.

capabilities.name: Manage Incidents & Interruptions
capabilities.description: Plan and respond to bursts, blockages, supply interruptions, flooding, and emergency events.

capabilities.name: Connect Customers & Developers
capabilities.description: Connect new properties and developments to the water and wastewater networks.

capabilities.name: Plan Assets
capabilities.description: Develop the asset investment plan against demand, risk, and regulatory price-review obligations.

capabilities.name: Acquire & Construct Assets
capabilities.description: Procure, build, and commission new assets.

capabilities.name: Operate Assets
capabilities.description: Operate assets within their performance envelope.

capabilities.name: Maintain Assets
capabilities.description: Inspect, maintain, and repair assets over their lifecycle.

capabilities.name: Decommission Assets
capabilities.description: Retire and dispose of end-of-life assets.

capabilities.name: Manage Tariffs & Products
capabilities.description: Design and price water and wastewater services, tariffs, and charges schemes.

capabilities.name: Read & Validate Meters
capabilities.description: Capture, validate, and estimate water meter readings.

capabilities.name: Generate Bills
capabilities.description: Produce accurate, timely customer bills, including unmeasured and assessed charges.

capabilities.name: Collect Payment
capabilities.description: Receive payment and manage payment methods.

capabilities.name: Manage Arrears
capabilities.description: Handle late payment, customer financial difficulty, affordability schemes, and recovery.

capabilities.name: Manage Licensing
capabilities.description: Hold and maintain the abstraction, discharge, and instrument-of-appointment licences required to operate.

capabilities.name: Report to Regulators
capabilities.description: Produce regulatory and statutory reports for Ofwat, the Environment Agency, and the Drinking Water Inspectorate.

capabilities.name: Manage Audits & Investigations
capabilities.description: Support audits and investigations and remediate findings.

capabilities.name: Manage Safety & Environment
capabilities.description: Discharge health, safety, drinking-water-quality, and environmental obligations.

capabilities.name: Measure Emissions & Discharges
capabilities.description: Quantify carbon emissions and monitor effluent and storm-overflow discharges across the value chain.

capabilities.name: Manage Energy & Resource Recovery
capabilities.description: Recover energy and resources from sludge and effluent, including biogas, heat, and biosolids.

capabilities.name: Manage Catchment & Biodiversity
capabilities.description: Run catchment, nature-based, and biodiversity schemes to protect source water and receiving environments.

capabilities.name: Report ESG Performance
capabilities.description: Disclose ESG performance to investors, regulators and the public.

capabilities.name: Manage Finance
capabilities.description: Accounting, treasury, planning, and tax.

capabilities.name: Manage People
capabilities.description: Hire, develop, pay and exit people.

capabilities.name: Manage Technology
capabilities.description: Provide IT infrastructure, applications and operating services to the business.

capabilities.name: Manage Procurement
capabilities.description: Source goods and services and manage supplier relationships.

capabilities.name: Generate Leads
capabilities.description: Identify and capture prospective business-retail and developer customers via marketing channels.

capabilities.name: Qualify Prospects
capabilities.description: Assess fit, creditworthiness and intent of prospects.

capabilities.name: Convert Sales
capabilities.description: Close the sale and capture the contract.

capabilities.name: Onboard Customer
capabilities.description: Provision service, register the supply point, and orient the customer.

capabilities.name: Notify Customer
capabilities.description: Notify customer of account closure and offboarding timeline.

capabilities.name: Handle Data Requests
capabilities.description: Process data deletion and data access requests per UK GDPR regulations.

capabilities.name: Close Account
capabilities.description: Close account and remove system access.

capabilities.name: Process Settlement
capabilities.description: Process final payment settlement and financial reconciliation.

capabilities.name: Notify Compliance & Legal
capabilities.description: Notify compliance, legal, and audit teams of customer offboarding.

capabilities.name: Schedule Treatment Processes
capabilities.description: Bring treatment streams online and offline according to plan and real-time demand.

capabilities.name: Manage Real-Time Treatment Performance
capabilities.description: Monitor and control treatment-process performance against operating targets.

capabilities.name: Water Quality Control
capabilities.description: Ensure output meets drinking-water-quality and discharge-consent requirements.

capabilities.name: Manage Bulk Supply Agreements
capabilities.description: Manage standing bulk supply agreements with neighbouring undertakers.

capabilities.name: Manage Inter-Company Transfers
capabilities.description: Operate short-term inter-company water transfers to balance resource zones.

capabilities.name: Negotiate Bulk Supply Contracts
capabilities.description: Negotiate longer-term bulk supply and trading arrangements.

capabilities.name: Plan Planned Interruptions
capabilities.description: Schedule and prepare planned supply interruptions for maintenance and works.

capabilities.name: Respond to Bursts & Blockages
capabilities.description: Detect, triage and restore from bursts, blockages, and unplanned interruptions.

capabilities.name: Communicate to Affected Customers
capabilities.description: Inform customers of interruption scope, cause, and restoration.

capabilities.name: Calculate Charges
capabilities.description: Apply tariffs and consumption data to calculate billable amounts.

capabilities.name: Validate Bills
capabilities.description: Validate bills for accuracy before dispatch.

capabilities.name: Dispatch Bills
capabilities.description: Deliver bills to customers via preferred channels.

activity.notes: Initial business capability catalogue established for the 1.0.0 baseline.
